title: Add a real read-only check mode to the authenticated DIO generator
description: P3 tooling correctness: generate_authenticated_schc_dio.py ignores all command-line arguments because main() accepts none and always calls atomic_write_json(). Invoking the repository-standard --check form therefore silently rewrites authenticated_schc_dio.json instead of validating it read-only, unlike the other scoped generators. Parse and reject arguments explicitly, implement byte-exact --check behavior through json_bytes(), and test that check mode performs no replacement or mtime change.
